gloss: to remove; to take away; to eliminate

definitions.gloss: to remove, to take away, to eliminate
definitions.explanation: To completely remove something unwanted or unnecessary. Emphasizes thorough removal so that nothing remains.

examples.japanese: {古|ふる}いペンキを{取|と}り{去|さ}ってから{塗|ぬ}り{直|なお}した。
examples.english: I stripped off the old paint before repainting.

examples.japanese: {長年|ながねん}の{不安|ふあん}を{取|と}り{去|さ}るには、{根本的|こんぽんてき}な{原因|げんいん}に{向|む}き{合|あ}う{必要|ひつよう}がある。
examples.english: To eliminate long-standing anxiety, you need to face its root cause.

notes:
CONJUGATION:
Godan verb ({五段動詞|ごだんどうし}), る-ending (godan, not ichidan).
- Negative: {取|と}り{去|さ}らない
- Polite: {取|と}り{去|さ}ります
- Te-form: {取|と}り{去|さ}って
- Past: {取|と}り{去|さ}った

USAGE:
Emphasizes complete removal with nothing left behind. Can be used both for physical removal (stains, objects) and abstract elimination (fears, obstacles). Somewhat more literary than {取|と}り{除|のぞ}く.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- シミを{取|と}り{去|さ}る: to remove a stain
- {汚|よご}れを{取|と}り{去|さ}る: to remove dirt
- {不安|ふあん}を{取|と}り{去|さ}る: to eliminate anxiety
- {障害|しょうがい}を{取|と}り{去|さ}る: to remove an obstacle

SIMILAR WORDS:
{取|と}り{去|さ}る emphasizes complete removal. {取|と}り{除|のぞ}く (to remove, to get rid of) is more common in everyday speech. {取|と}り{払|はら}う (to clear away) emphasizes clearing or sweeping away.
